description: This file defines the Signer class used for creating signed URLs and cookies for AWS CloudFront. It handles generating signatures, creating policies, and encoding these for secure content distribution.

classes.name: Signer
classes.description: A class responsible for creating signatures used by AWS CloudFront for signed URLs and cookies, encapsulating policy creation, signing, and encoding logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Signer with key pair ID and private key, checking for the OpenSSL extension and loading the private key handle.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Frees the private key resource if PHP version is less than 8.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Generates signature components for signed URLs or cookies based on resource, expiration, and policy.

methods.name: createCannedPolicy
methods.description: Creates a JSON policy for URL signing with resource and expiration.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs the policy using the private key and returns the signature.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a policy or signature in a URL-safe base64 format.
